voice: A warm, confident narrator in her thirties with a clear, slightly low voice and a neutral American accent. Relaxed and precise, like a filmmaker who also writes code. Close microphone, studio quality, no background noise.
style: calm, measured pace, slightly slower, warm and assured
audition: Point Repotage at a repo, and Playwright, Vox C P M and Ace Step turn it into a film.

lines.text: This voice was designed from one sentence of text. The music, the captions and every cut came out of one repo.
It's called Repotage. Point it at a project, and it makes the demo.
lines.say: It's called Repo-tahzh. Point it at a project, and it makes the demo.

lines.text: Claude reads the code, picks one story worth telling, and writes the script.
Playwright films the real product at twice the resolution, and logs every click.
Vox C P M designs the narrator. WhisperX checks each take and times every word.
Ace Step writes the score, and ducks it under the voice.
HyperFrames and Gee Sap cut it together in HTML, frame by frame.
It all renders on one Mac, with open models.
Repotage. Point it at a repo. Get a film.
lines.say: Repo-tahzh. Point it at a repo. Get a film.
